{{Top|leg}}
The '''Flamestrike Legion''' was a military organization that defended the [[Bamula sector/Legends|Bamula sector]] from foreign insurrections before the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Small and well trained, the Flamestrike Legion was a cohesive unit that wore a distinctive [[Flamestriker armor|mustard-yellow armor]]. Although they had a reputation for being invincible, they met their match against the Empire and were forcibly disbanded. [[Norjax Thall]] previously served in the Flamestrike Legion.
